{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma1
|version1= 1.00

|game2= arma2
|version2= 1.00

|game3= arma2oa
|version3= 1.50

|game4= tkoh
|version4= 1.00

|game5= arma3
|version5= 0.50

|gr1= Environment

|gr2= Sounds

|eff= local

|descr= Enable/disable environmental effects: ambient life and/or ambient sound.

{{Feature|informative|This command has to be executed after mission start: be sure to use e.g <sqf inline>sleep 0.1;</sqf> for it to take effect.}}
Influenced sounds among others are:
{{Columns|2|
* bird sounds
* insect sounds
* waves
* wind
* rain
* sounds produced by air conditioners and similar
}}
* {{GVI|arma3|2.06|size= 0.75}} thunder (an already started sound will not be cut but future ones will be prevented)

|s1= [[enableEnvironment]] enable

|p1= enable: [[Boolean]] - [[false]] to disable ambient life and ambient sounds, [[true]] to re-enable it

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= [[enableEnvironment]] [ambientLife, ambientSound, windyCoef]

|s2since= arma3 1.68

|p21= ambientLife: [[Boolean]] - enable/disable ambient life (bees, rabbits, birds, snakes, fish)

|p22= ambientSound: [[Boolean]] - enable/disable ambient sounds (cicadas, owls, etc)

|p23= windyCoef: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 1) howling wind at heights, range 0..1
|p23since= arma3 2.12

|r2= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>enableEnvironment false; // identical to enableEnvironment [false, false]</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
enableEnvironment [false, true];
enableEnvironment [false, true, 0.5]; // since {{arma3}} v2.12
</sqf>

|seealso= [[environmentEnabled]] [[fadeEnvironment]] [[environmentVolume]] [[initAmbientLife]] [[sideAmbientLife]] [[getAllEnvSoundControllers]] [[getEnvSoundController]] [[setSoundEffect]] [[Arma 3: Animals: Ambient System]]
}}
